{{Quote|They're still ''around here'' someplace-- and I'm not ''leaving'' this jungle-infested planet without them-- even if we have to ''ray-blast'' them!|Imperial commander|<ref name="DYKWYCA" />}}
The '''battle of Keeper's World''' was a running battle from the space around [[Keeper's World]] to its surface. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were spared when they discovered [[The Keeper]], who faked their deaths and drove the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces into retreat.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|That's why we need them ''with'' us. When we reach the ''second Rebel base'' in the star-system ''Akuria...'' there may be ''other'' droids there, which only ''they'' can talk to!|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="UPSWS1" />}}
Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] feared sneak attacks from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Feeling communication between Rebel bases was the key to preventing such an attack, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] were sent to the [[Akuria Rebel Base]] on [[Akuria II]]. Accompanying them were [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], both to communicate with any [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Akuria II, and so R2-D2 could navigate their [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

Unfortunately a malfunction in R2-D2 caused by damage sustained during the Battle of Yavin sent them off course, and they emerged from hyperspace in the [[Keeper's World system/Legends|Keeper's World system]], where they discovered an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet consisting of a number of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="UPSWS1" /> They were swiftly detected by a Star Destroyer, and the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Keeper's World)|commander of the vessel]] ordered the Rebel ship captured.<ref name="UPSWS2" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|They had a good head start, but they're losing it. For some reason, they don't seem to want to leave their two ''droids'' behind.|Imperial commander|<ref name="PATR">{{StoryCite|story=Pursuit among the Ruins!|book=Pizzazz 5}}</ref>}}
Despite malfunctioning earlier, R2-D2's calculations coupled with Luke Skywalker's piloting skills allowed the Rebel scout craft to evade the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] of the Star Destroyers, but not without suffering heavy damage and crash landing on [[Keeper's World]].<ref name="UPSWS2" />

At first Luke Skywalker's band of Rebels believed that since Keeper's World was uncharted, they might be safe from Imperial pursuit. However, the Imperials soon detected the crashed scout craft, and the Imperial commander took a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to the planet's surface to capture or destroy the Rebels.<ref name="DD" /> This resulted in a running battle across the surface of the planet, with the Rebels seeking to evade the pursuing Stormtroopers. The presence of two droids slowed the Rebel's progress, driving them to hide in a [[Keeper's Temple|ruined temple]].<ref name="PATR" />

A mysterious [[Teleportal|device]] teleported the Rebels inside the temple, where they discovered the planet was not as uninhabited as they had previously believed. They met the strange androids [[Fire (individual)|Fire]], [[Rain (droid)|Rain]], [[Wind (android)|Wind]], and [[Earth (droid)|Earth]],<ref name="DYKWYCA" /> and their creator, [[The Keeper]], an ancient computer tasked with restoring the war-ravaged world to its former glory before the return of the planet's [[Keeper's makers|original inhabitants]].<ref name="TKS">{{StoryCite|story=The Keeper's Secret!|book=Pizzazz 8}}</ref>

The Keeper, fearing that the ongoing battle might disrupt her work, sheltered the Rebels while triggering a cataclysmic [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]. This not only convinced the Imperials that the Rebels had been killed, but it drove them away from the planet.<ref name="TFF" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I'll ''miss'' the Keeper and her children, Luke... but things will be more ''peaceful'' for them now.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="TFF" />}}
The Imperials never learned of the Keeper's existence, and thus believed the groundquakes to be natural and the planet unstable. The Imperial commander warned all Imperial units to avoid the planet in the future, for their own safety. Meanwhile on the planet the Keeper repaired the Rebel scout craft, allowing the Rebels to continue on their mission to Akuria II, and leave the Keeper to her own long mission to restore the planet for her creators.<ref name="TFF" />
